text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O and I are visiting a shrine, when…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, gods! Make my brilliance shine brighter still! May my grace bring greater warmth unto all…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As it is so. Thus, on these shoulders, I bear the weight of all aspirations. I, on the Overlord's path…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew… Hopefully the gods will be in a better mood now.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes. You see, I have been so busy in my overlordly duties serving the people that I haven't had time to come visit them.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What can be troubling is if I offend the gods once, they'll play foul tricks on my health to get attention.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I cannot deliver my radiance to the world with this shadow cast unto me! That is why…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh… This is the worst timing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Have you also come here to speak with me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No! I just… wanted to look at the stars.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Concealing your true aspirations in the face of my majesty—how courageous!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With my brilliance that shines brighter than any star, I shall fulfill your precious little desire!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Wait, where are you going with this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: FLASH!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is that light?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My ambition, of course!
choice_data_list: No, that's got to be the moon…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's no way… The moon could never be that bright.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaah ha ha ha! My splendor is supreme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is the light we're seeing from the moon, or could it truly be T.M. Opera O's shining ambition?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever the case, the shadow cast over her has been cleared! Her commanding radiance is returned!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack! Boom! Rumble…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas! The gods lament… It would seem they want me all to themselves.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fear not—I am the Overlord! It is my duty to spread my affection equally!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No matter if storm clouds brew… or my health crumble!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, gods! I shall cry out again, and still more, until you finally understand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dark clouds continue to shadow T.M. Opera O's radiance.
